rows.text: An arcade machine appears in front of you in the deserted Interastral Department Store building. Trendy gachapon figures, ether orbs, and clay dolls are stacked inside the display cabinet. Electronic music and colorful lights come alive as you approach.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I'm the perfect man in the arcade!" The arcade machine starts to play an electronic voice. You suppose this was added by a playful programmer...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You can't help but shudder - You suspect that there must be a catch!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
